skill.name: video-downloader
skill.description: Guides AI assistants through video download requests, including quality choices, audio-only requests, playlists, batch downloads, and responsible-use reminders.
skill.summary: Guide video download requests with format, quality, batch, and permission checks.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences around prompt examples. No executable code, shell invocation, data exfiltration, or prompt injection was found in SKILL.md. The remaining concern is low misuse risk from downloading media without permission.

remediation.suggestion: Require users to confirm they own the content or have download rights before starting any download.
State that the skill must refuse DRM circumvention, paywall bypass, private content access, and redistribution requests.

remediation.issue: Future executable implementations could add command risk
remediation.suggestion: If downloader code is added later, avoid shell interpolation and use fixed argument arrays with validated URLs.

content.value_statement: Offline media workflows can be slow when quality, format, and permission requirements are unclear. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structure responsible video, audio, playlist, and batch download requests.
actual_capabilities: Provides prompt patterns for single video downloads.
Supports quality requests such as 480p, 720p, 1080p, and 4K.
Describes playlist and batch download requests.
Suggests preserving title, description, and thumbnails.
Includes reminders about copyright, fair use, and platform terms.
limitations: Does not include executable downloader code or installation instructions.
Cannot verify whether a user has permission to download a video.
Downloads may fail when a platform blocks access or changes behavior.
Users must provide legal, accessible video URLs.

use_cases.title: Prepare Offline Lessons
use_cases.description: Save permitted lecture videos and tutorials for classrooms with limited connectivity.

use_cases.title: Archive Research Sources
use_cases.description: Capture allowed conference talks or public reference videos with metadata for later citation review.

use_cases.title: Collect Owned Creator Assets
use_cases.description: Download owned uploads, thumbnails, and audio for editing, backups, or approved channel publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Download One Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Download this video for offline viewing: [URL]. Use the best available MP4 quality that stays under [SIZE LIMIT].

prompt_templates.title: Extract Audio
prompt_templates.prompt: Download only the audio from this permitted video: [URL]. Save it as [FORMAT] and include the source title.

prompt_templates.title: Save a Playlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Download this playlist: [URL]. Use [QUALITY], preserve titles and thumbnails, and skip unavailable items.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Batch Archive
prompt_templates.prompt: Download these permitted videos into [FOLDER]. Use consistent filenames, record metadata, and summarize any failures.

output_examples.input: Download this allowed tutorial in 720p for offline viewing.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms permission, selects 720p MP4, downloads the video, and reports filename, duration, size, and save location.

output_examples.input: Extract audio from my uploaded webinar.
output_examples.output: The assistant saves an audio-only file, keeps the original title, and notes the source URL for your records.

output_examples.input: Archive a playlist of public conference talks.
output_examples.output: The assistant processes each permitted playlist item, saves thumbnails, and summarizes completed, skipped, and failed downloads.

best_practices: Download only content you own, licensed content, or content you have clear permission to save.
Specify quality, format, destination folder, and file size limits before starting.
Keep source URLs and metadata with archived files for future review.
anti_patterns: Using the skill to bypass paywalls, DRM, private access controls, or platform restrictions.
Redistributing downloaded copyrighted media without explicit permission.
Starting large playlist downloads without checking storage, bandwidth, and permission boundaries.

faq.question: Does this skill include downloader software?
faq.answer: No. It provides assistant instructions and prompt patterns, not executable downloader code.

faq.question: Can it download from YouTube?
faq.answer: It describes YouTube-style requests, but actual support depends on available tools, platform rules, and user permission.

faq.question: Can I choose video quality?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports quality requests such as 480p, 720p, 1080p, and 4K.

faq.question: Can it extract audio only?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes prompts for audio-only downloads when the source is permitted.

faq.question: Is it safe for copyrighted content?
faq.answer: Use it only for content you own, licensed content, or uses allowed by law and platform terms.

faq.question: Can it handle multiple videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes playlist and batch request patterns, but large jobs should define limits first.
